resolved_findings.resolution: The pull_request_target workflow checks out the exact event base commit and runs only base verifier code. Candidate requests and changes are read as Git objects.

resolved_findings.finding: Delayed compromise through an unprotected verifier dependency
resolved_findings.resolution: The complete implementation/garden_kernel/ prefix, authoritative scripts, workflow subtree and admission subtree are classified as constitutional by trusted base code.

resolved_findings.finding: Rename, deletion, content or mode scope bypass
resolved_findings.resolution: The admission compares the complete raw no-renames Git diff with full before/after object IDs and modes. Diff paths are represented only by SHA-256 of their UTF-8 bytes under the mandatory SHA256_UTF8 encoding marker, preventing prohibited path wording from being reintroduced into the admission record while retaining exact path binding.

resolved_findings.finding: Replay across repositories, pull requests, source identities or request payloads
resolved_findings.resolution: The admission binds repository, pull-request number, DesignEpoch, canonical source root, mandatory baseline-tree digest, exact change set, exact request hashes and expiry.
The trusted loader derives governance/human_admissions/PR-<number>.json from a validated positive integer pull-request number.
The workflow fetches refs/pull/<number>/head and requires FETCH_HEAD to equal github.event.pull_request.head.sha before invoking the gate.

resolved_findings.finding: Malformed admission or request could escape without a rejecting report
resolved_findings.resolution: Typed admission validation and the authoritative wrapper's fail-closed exception boundary preserve rejection.

authority_boundary.human_record: The admission is an agent record of an observed explicit user instruction under the existing v1.4 human root. It is not a cryptographic human signature.

external_merge_condition: Branch-required-check configuration is outside this repository review. Before merge, require all CI and the authoritative trusted-base-admission workflow to succeed for the final exact PR head; any candidate change after this review requires regenerated admission bindings and a fresh exact-head result.
admission_record_hash_excluded: The admission record hash is intentionally excluded because adding this review changes the candidate diff and requires mechanical regeneration of the admission record.
